archive-restore.current: A rectangular box identical in shape to an archive box, but with an upward-pointing arrow emerging from inside the box through the open top. The arrow indicates content being lifted out or exported upward.
archive-restore.usage: Unarchive or restore an item from archive, export from a storage container, retrieve a stored file, move content out of a folder.

zoom-out.current: A magnifying glass with a minus sign inside the circular lens — identical in shape to a standard search icon but with a horizontal dash replacing the typical center detail.
zoom-out.usage: Zoom out on a map or image, decrease text size, remove a search filter, collapse a detail view.

badge-check.current: A badge-shaped outline (scalloped/starburst edge) with a check mark centered inside. Identical border shape to the exclamation badge, but the interior symbol is a tick/checkmark rather than an exclamation mark.
badge-check.usage: Verified account or identity badge; certified or approved status on a listing; trust indicator next to a username; marking a completed certification or credential.

info.current: A circle outline with a lowercase 'i' (information symbol) centered inside. The border is a smooth perfect circle — identical shape to the warning circle and question circle icons, differentiated only by the 'i' glyph.
info.usage: Inline information tooltip trigger; informational status indicator next to a label; help text toggle; neutral informational notice in a notification system.

camera-off.current: A camera icon identical in shape to a standard camera (rounded body, circular lens, top bump) but with a diagonal strikethrough line crossing from the lower-left to the upper-right, indicating the camera is disabled or unavailable.
camera-off.usage: Camera permission denied states, disabling camera in video call settings, indicating no camera detected, muting video input in a conference call.

bell-dot.current: A bell icon identical in shape to a standard notification bell, but with a small filled circle in the upper-right corner of the bell dome, indicating an unread or active notification badge.
bell-dot.usage: Unread notification indicator, new alert badge on the notification icon, unseen activity alert, push notification pending state

lock-open.current: An open padlock identical in body shape to the closed version, but with the U-shaped shackle raised and pivoted to the right so it no longer closes the lock.
lock-open.usage: Unlocked or public content states, disabling a lock action, unsecured connection warnings, toggling permissions off.

shield-alert.current: A shield outline identical in shape to the plain shield, but with a bold exclamation mark centered inside it, indicating a warning or alert state.
shield-alert.usage: Security warning or vulnerability alert, account at risk notification, failed security check, suspicious activity banner.

shield-check.current: A shield outline identical in shape to the plain shield, but with a checkmark centered inside it, indicating a verified or secure state.
shield-check.usage: Verified or trusted status badge, successful security scan result, secure transaction confirmation, two-factor authentication success.

shield-x.current: A shield outline identical in shape to the plain shield, but with a bold X (cross) centered inside it, indicating rejection, failure, or a blocked state.
shield-x.usage: Security check failed, blocked or rejected access, antivirus threat detected, permission denied indicator.
